premises.text: Organizations increasingly rely on contractors and vendors rather than full-time employees
premises.evidence_span: they all have twice as many contractors and vendors doing work for them than they have full-time employees

premises.text: Current workflows for managing contractors and vendors are inefficient
premises.evidence_span: this whole workflow process between companies to outsource parties is a complete mess and super inefficient

premises.text: A centralized management system can streamline contractor onboarding and project management
premises.evidence_span: All of their contributor network information, past and future, will be stored in one place, accessible by all of their employees

premises.text: Feedback and performance tracking are essential for managing contractor quality
premises.evidence_span: tracking who's good at what within an organization, like institutional knowledge, is always lost

premises.text: The shift towards independent contracting is significant and growing
premises.evidence_span: 60% of the world's workforce will be independent contractors too

premises.text: Companies need tools to adapt to the increasing number of independent contractors
premises.evidence_span: the current workplace is not equipped to handle this shift

value.text: Companies can efficiently manage and communicate with a diverse group of contractors
value.evidence_span: how we're helping companies like Google, like The Economist, onboard, manage, communicate with, and pay these huge contributor networks

notes: No traction metrics or external funding details included.
